title: Kusanagi Nene — Gentle Encouragement From Afar〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hello. Looking forward to another day working with you all.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi! School's finished for the day?

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Let's have another great day of practice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've got to do my best leading up to the 30th Anniversary Show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll start with some stretching...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene! Wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Oh, Emu, it's just you... You surprised me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ Let's do our best at practice today, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. By the way, you seem really happy. Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We had a briefing on our field trip today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Field trip?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, all of the first-years will be going to Yokohama this year☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yokohama, huh? I'm sure there's a lot of things to see there, like the harbor or Chinatown.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We've formed all of our groups too! I'm in the same group as Honami♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You and Mochizuki are in the same class. Are there other people from your class in the group?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! A friend from gymnastics club and two of Honami's friends♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So five people altogether. Sounds like fun. Do you know where you'll be going in Yokohama?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, all of the first-years will be going to the History Archive Museum together first.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right, I guess to all do some studying at the same place. And then?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We get to go wherever we want to go in our groups!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But that's what Honami, the others and I are discussing right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We want to go see the Ferris wheel and try lots of yummy things in Chinatown!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right, there's a huge Ferris wheel at the harbor. And Yokohama is also known for the Chinatown there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we also talked about going to the instant noodle museum too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Instant noodle museum? I didn't know there was a place like that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami said she wants to go since you can pick your favorite ingredients and make your own instant noodles in a cup!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? That does sound pretty interesting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What about the Red Brick Center? Isn't that also a well-known spot?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We're also thinking about whether or not to go there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's so many places we want to go to that Honami's friend was all “I wish there was more time!” and “If only we could clone ourselves!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I get how she feels. Since you're already going, why wouldn't you want to see everything?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If Emu's going, that means Hoshino and Hinomori would be as well...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Their solo show really was amazing.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This next song will be our last...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Even after it was over, my heart was pounding so much...
I kept talking with Emu and the others about the show after we went to watch it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I still had this warm feeling after I got home, and I ended up calling Hoshino on a whim too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The way you sang with such confidence up there today was so cool...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It made me think, “Wow, my friend is amazing.” After that, I felt like I should be more brave.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It made me want to work harder, so that I can stand on stage the same way you did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Kusanagi...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry for dumping all of that out of nowhere. That was weird.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <No, not at all. Let's both keep working hard.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope they all have fun on their field trip.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene! I'll bring back lots and lots of souvenirs, okay☆ Look forward to it♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, I should start stretching now. Did you want to join me, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪
